literature_notes: The sole ledger line (L1) describes a Syncytin-1 cDNA construct tagged with a V5 epitope from a commercial GeneCopoeia plasmid (#T0264). The clip does not state where in the protein the V5 tag is inserted. This falls squarely under the explicit disqualification rule: 'a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue.' Topology-derived reasoning cannot rescue it: Syncytin-1 has its N-terminus extracellular (mature N-terminus at residue 21, after signal-peptide cleavage at 1–20) and its C-terminus intracellular (residues 465–538). A tag placed before the signal peptide would be cleaved off; a C-terminal tag would be intracellular; an internal tag position is entirely unspecified. Because the ledger provides no positional information, no surface tag site can be proposed. Zero sites is the correct answer.
